text:
sarah_sales: FYI prospect 'Marlin Health' is asking if we can take their FalconX-30b variant for a POC. They want Dedicated + Private, FIPS KMS, and a rough cost/latency estimate. Also: they're using an int4 quant variant and a custom KV layout. Can eng help with a compatibility checklist?

raj_eng: quick read: we need three compatibility checks: kernel/instruction set, KV format parity, and tokenizer mapping. If any of those fail we fall back to a compatible open model. :thinking_face:

catalog-bot: compat-scan queued for falconx-30b@falconx-v1 (scan id 84231). Results ETA ~25m.

marta_se: Important: tokenization mismatches are the most common gotcha. Ask Marlin for a sample of their token ids for the top 10 tokens and a small export (first 1000 tokens) so we can run a tokenizer parity test. Also need to confirm whether their preprocessing adds BOS/EOS or uses EOS-only.

diego_infra: For Private with customer KMS/HSM — we have an HSM plugin path but FIPS validation takes time. Typical timeline: HSM integration smoke tests (3 business days) + FIPS validation + legal review (10 business days). If they need SOC2 + FIPS before POC kickoff plan for ~3 weeks. We can run a non-FIPS test in ~2 days if they accept a demo without HSM turned on.

raj_eng: For the int4 quant variant: we support int4 if quant profile matches our kernel packing. Quick command to run locally (use our internal scanner):
```
# run variant compatibility scanner
rwdctl compat scan --model falconx-30b --variant falconx-v1 --checks=kv,tokenizer,kernels,quant --out=scan-84231.json
```
Expected snippet when pass:
```
{
  "kv": "OK: layout=linear, stride=64",
  "tokenizer": "OK: byte-level BPE",
  "kernels": "OK: avx2/ampere kernels available",
  "quant": "WARN: int4 uses asymmetric zero point, recommend profile 'int4-signed'"
}
```
If quant returns WARN we can still serve but need to add a quant shim and note small perf delta.

marta_se: Also flag for sales: does Marlin require token-level privacy or are logs allowed for the POC? If they require no logs we need to enable privacy-mode in Dedicated (disables some tracing features).

sarah_sales: They're ok with sanitized logs for now but legal wants the security questionnaire answered before any infra is touched. There's an attached SQ we need to fill (I'll upload separately). Can eng/infra review Qs about key rotation and data at rest?

diego_infra: On key rotation + KMS: we support customer-managed keys via KMS v2 and can configure automatic rotation policy to their rotation cadence. For Private deploy we mount a KM plugin with: 
```
kms: 
  provider: customer-hsm
  endpoint: https://kms.marlin.example 
  fips_mode: true
```
We need Marlin's KMS certs and ACLs to set up the plugin.

lex_pm: For model catalog metadata we should add fields so sales has a one-glance summary. Proposed fields: compatible_kv_formats, tokenizer_family, quant_profiles, required_kernels, fips_compatible (true/false), recommended_fallback. Raj can you add this to the catalog entry if scan passes?

raj_eng: Yep — will update catalog entry after the compat-scan. Example catalog snippet I'll add: 
```
model_id: falconx-30b
variant: falconx-v1
compatible_kv_formats: ["linear", "interleaved"]
tokenizer_family: "byte-level-bpe"
quant_profiles: ["fp16","int8","int4-signed"]
required_kernels: ["cuda_ampere_fused_matmul","avx2_attention_opt"]
fips_compatible: "partial"  # depends on HSM validation
recommended_fallback: "open-30b"
```

catalog-bot: scan 84231 completed: kv=OK, tokenizer=OK, kernels=OK, quant=CAUTION (int4 requires shim). Uploading report to https://internal.redwood/compat/reports/84231

marta_se: Action items: 1) Sarah — get token sample + security questionnaire from Marlin (due EOD tomorrow). 2) Raj — run scanner and add catalog fields if green (ETA 6h). 3) Diego — draft KMS integration checklist and timeline (ETA 2 business days). 4) Lex — prepare a POC pricing stub (Dedicated capacity + Private infra delta + HSM validation buffer).

sarah_sales: Assigning owners in my tracker. Marlin asked for a cost ballpark now — can Lex drop rough numbers we can present in the RFP?

lex_pm: Rough ballpark for a 2-week POC (dedicated medium pool + private infra + HSM support + eng onboarding): $45k-$70k depending on burst capacity. I'll put a line-item breakdown into the doc and share a short slide.

raj_eng: Note on rollout: if the int4 shim is needed, recommend canary 5% traffic -> monitor latency p95 and quality delta vs fallback. Also pin a fallback route to open-30b in routing policy.

marta_se: For the security questionnaire, I'll pair with Diego on the KMS answers — send it to me when you upload, Sarah.

sarah_sales: Uploaded SQ and token sample (sensitive channel). Thanks team — I'll update Marlin with the timeline: compat scan results in ~30m, catalog update same day if green, KMS integration planning 2-3 weeks if FIPS required. Will share Lex's price ballpark now. :thumbsup:

diego_infra: one more: if Marlin insists on air-gapped POC we need an on-prem package quote; that's a separate cost and typically adds 1-2 weeks for env prep.

sarah_sales: noted. closing loop here, will follow up with any blockers.
